A '''battle''' took place in the [[Gamor system/Legends|Gamor system]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], in [[3996 BBY]]. The Republic ultimately emerged victorious.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Gamor makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
